prose: Split from b15da5656579 under RULE 1 (orchestrator 2026-11-16, relaying Akien: "the latest entry remains in cairn commons, and everything else broken into... per day? per week? inside of our .cairn/logs folder"). cairn/tools/question/probes/both_ends_agree.py reads the artifact journal for every question and answer event since its build. After b15d the journal holds only the newest entry per path, so an open-then-answer pair on one question file reads as the answer alone. The probe must read artifact.read_trail(root), every entry this box's doors wrote in 30 days. It then sees only 30 days, and the ticket says so.
